# Volume 1 timeline

## CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in his finest clothes, sparking her curiosity. She visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate and learns from [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that they are adopting an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) on the farm. Mrs. Rachel expresses strong disapproval and warns [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) of the risks involved before departing to spread the news.

## CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to the [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) train station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, but instead finds an imaginative, talkative young girl waiting for him. Learning from the stationmaster that there has been a mistake, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) decides to take her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to let [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) handle the situation. As they drive away together in the buggy, the young girl chatters enthusiastically about her life, her wild imaginations, and her distress over her red hair.

**[Barry](../character/barry.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) drives the young girl through the [Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) and past local landmarks like Barry's pond as she chatters animatedly and renames the sights around them. She successfully guesses which house is [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), filling her with joy while [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) dreads the moment she learns the truth about the mistake.

## CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked to discover that an orphan girl was sent instead of a boy. Upon realizing she is unwanted, [Anne](../character/anne.md) breaks down in tears, introduces herself, and insists on spelling her name with an 'E'. After a brief, uneventful supper, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) puts [Anne](../character/anne.md) to bed in the east gable room, before discussing with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) down in the kitchen how to return her.

## CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), Snow Queen** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the surrounding scenery before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tells her to get dressed for breakfast. Over a silent meal, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) becomes uncomfortable with Anne's intense imagination and quiet mood, while noticing Matthew's persistent desire to keep the girl. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps with chores, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to drive her to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to see Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), leaving [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) behind as they set off in the buggy.

## CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md), [Hammond](../character/hammond.md), Hopeton, [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md)** — During the drive to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), [Anne](../character/anne.md) resolves to enjoy the journey despite her dread of being sent away. Asked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to share her true background, [Anne](../character/anne.md) recounts her life as an orphan, describing her parents' deaths and her childhood moving between homes and looking after children before being sent to the asylum. Listening to Anne's history, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) begins to feel deep pity for the neglected child and considers whether they should keep her after all.

## CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Blewett](../character/blewett.md), [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md), Green Gables, [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) arrive at Mrs. Spencer's home, where they clarify the mix-up regarding the boy they had requested. Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) arrives and offers to take [Anne](../character/anne.md) in as a servant, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates after seeing Anne's distress and decides to bring her back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew.md). Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) talks it over with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay.

## CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne.md) up to bed and instructs her on keeping her room tidy and saying her bedtime prayers. Upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne.md) has never said a prayer, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prompts her to invent one, resulting in an unconventional prayer from [Anne](../character/anne.md). Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and tells [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) that they must properly educate and raise the girl.

## CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) have decided to keep her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), sending [Anne](../character/anne.md) into tears of joy. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) assigns [Anne](../character/anne.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, though Anne's vivid imagination repeatedly distracts her in both the sitting room and kitchen. After discussing the possibility of finding a friend in [Diana Barry](../character/di.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) is sent to her room, where she finishes learning her prayer and happily daydreams by the window.

## CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and insults Anne's appearance, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to fly into a furious rage and insult Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) in return. After Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne.md) in her bedroom and demands she apologize, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) fiercely refuses.

## CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — After [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses to leave her room or eat, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) secretly visits her and gently convinces her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) to smooth things over. [Anne](../character/anne.md) dramatic apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who forgives her completely and offers her hope about her hair color. Walking back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels an unaccustomed warmth toward [Anne](../character/anne.md) as the young girl expresses her happiness at finally having a home.

## CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne.md) with three plain new dresses, sparking Anne's disappointment over the lack of fashionable puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home with a headache while [Anne](../character/anne.md) decorates her hat with wild flowers and attends Sunday school alone. Upon returning, [Anne](../character/anne.md) recounts her experiences at church and Sunday school, including her observations about the other girls' puffed sleeves and the minister's sermon.

## CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne.md) for putting wild flowers on her hat, but then brings her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/di.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) quickly hit it off in the garden, solemnly vowing to be best friends forever. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) a package of chocolate sweets, bringing her immense joy.

## CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) calls [Anne](../character/anne.md) inside to do her patchwork sewing and questions her for staying late with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) excitedly asks to attend the upcoming Sunday-school picnic, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) grants permission, agreeing to bake a basket of food for her. [Anne](../character/anne.md) talks animatedly about her playhouse with [Diana](../character/diana.md) and her anticipation of the picnic, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her prized amethyst brooch.

## CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) suspects [Anne](../character/anne.md) of taking her missing amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. Desperate to attend the upcoming picnic, [Anne](../character/anne.md) fabricates a dramatic story about losing the brooch in the water, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway as punishment. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her own lace shawl, apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne.md), and quickly sends her off to enjoy the picnic.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), Shining Waters** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake in suspecting [Anne](../character/anne.md) and forgives her for the false confession, quickly sending her off to the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns overjoyed after having a wonderful time eating ice cream and boating on the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Later that evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shares the entire story with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), admitting she learned a valuable lesson.

## CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk to school while discussing their classmates, including [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teases [Anne](../character/anne.md) by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and she refuses to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Tillie Boulter](../character/tillie-boulter.md)** — After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to leave school permanently. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay home until she cools down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) finds [Anne](../character/anne.md) weeping over imaginary future sorrow about [Diana](../character/diana.md) getting married, which sends [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) into a rare fit of laughter.

## CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana.md) over for tea while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) attends a meeting in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). During the visit, [Anne](../character/anne.md) inadvertently serves [Diana](../character/diana.md) three glassfuls of homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana.md) to feel dizzy and sick and go home early. On Monday, [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns that Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) believes she deliberately got [Diana](../character/diana.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together, whereupon [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the wine bottle and realizes her mistake in storing it.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) believes she intentionally got [Diana](../character/diana.md) drunk, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally gave [Diana](../character/diana.md) currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. After [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) fails to convince Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) that it was an innocent mistake, [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize herself, but Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) coldly turns her away. Heartbroken, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later softens with sympathy after finding the sleeping child.

## CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) share a tearful, romantic farewell after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne.md). Consoled by their devotion and a exchanged lock of hair, [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed back by her classmates and receives a secret note of friendship from [Diana](../character/diana.md). She dedicates herself to her studies, engaging in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while maintaining her silence toward him.

## CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [God](../character/god.md), Green Gables, [Hammond](../character/hammond.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md)** — While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) spend a quiet evening together studying and talking. [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) rushes in to beg for help because her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) is gravely ill with croup while their parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne.md) hurries to the [Barry](../character/barry.md) home and successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) using her past experience with Mrs. Hammond's children, saving the baby's life. Touched by Anne's rescue, Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forgives her for the past incident with [Diana](../character/diana.md), allowing the two girls to be best friends once again.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) visited, apologized for the previous misunderstanding, and invited [Anne](../character/anne.md) over to see [Diana](../character/diana.md). Overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne.md) rushes off without a wrap and later returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her wonderful afternoon reconciling with [Diana](../character/diana.md) and enjoying a formal tea.

## CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md)** — After [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne.md) attend a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night at Diana's, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) enjoy the event together. Upon returning home, they leap into the spare-room bed as a game, unwittingly jumping directly onto Diana's visiting great-aunt, [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md). The resulting uproar leaves [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) furious and threatens Diana's music lessons, prompting a remorseful [Anne](../character/anne.md) to seek a way to make amends.

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her mistake with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) before going to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to take the blame directly. She bravely confronts the angry Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) and explains her perspective, winning over the old lady with her sincerity and imagination. [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after all, and she and [Anne](../character/anne.md) become firm friends.

## CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on the arrival of spring and her first year living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to retrieve an apron pattern from the Barrys' house at dusk, [Anne](../character/anne.md) confesses that she and [Diana](../character/diana.md) imagined the spruce grove to be the "[Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood)." To break [Anne](../character/anne.md) of her frightening imaginings, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists she walk through the woods anyway, resulting in a terrifying trip for [Anne](../character/anne.md).

## CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Bentley](../character/bentley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns from school emotional about Mr. Phillips's departure and shares news of the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. After praising Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and making extensive preparations with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) bakes a layer cake for the minister and his wife's visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). ## Chapter 40
